text_block_list.name: Fan Near the Stage
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-saaan! Do your best~! <chrname>~! I came to 
cheer for you~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So many people have come to watch the 
stage performance today as well."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, indeed. Wishes are potent medicine, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Hope is about looking at the possibility 
of 'what if.'"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, a wish adds hope onto mere 
probability, yearning for things 'to be 
so.'

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The masses are foolish. Without even 
making that distinction, they simply 
project their own desires onto others.
choice_data_list:
However, you can also turn that into your 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you going to change into your 
outfit, Tachyon? The stage is about to 
start.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, my apologies! My, you truly are 
quite honest, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why she experiences 
such honest growth. ...She has served as a 
magnificent sample."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume, including <chrname>, gather one 
after another by the side of the 4th Live 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I hope they draw strength from this 
concert as well." With that wish in mind, 
I sent them out onto the stage.
